mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return in the S&P 500.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 60-day forward return in the S&P 500.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ > 3% does not lead to a statistically significant positive 20-day forward return in the S&P 500.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 5-day forward return in the S&P 500.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 does not lead to a statistically significant positive 20-day forward return in the S&P 500.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM < -10% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return in the S&P 500.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in strong labor market
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 60-day forward return in the S&P 500.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing above 3% quarter-over-quarter and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing by more than 2.5% year-over-year, the combination signals strong demand with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of GDPC1 QoQ > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to a statistically significant positive 20-day forward return in the S&P 500.
